item.title: Our Little Cat Cafe
item.description:
A cafe with room for whiskers

Neko Atsume Cafe is a cozy neighborhood stop for coffee lovers and cat people alike. Come in for a warm drink, settle into a comfortable corner, and let the cats set the pace.

The cats come first

Every cat has their own favorite perch, pace, and way of saying hello. We keep the cafe calm and give our resident cats plenty of choice and space, so a good visit always starts with treating them gently.

item.title: Misty
item.description: Misty loves cuddles and chasing laser pointers. She is very social and good with kids.

item.title: Snowball
item.description:
Snowball is a sweet, affectionate young kitten with a heart as soft as her fur. She greets everyone with bright eyes and a gentle purr the moment they walk into the room, making it impossible not to fall for her.

Cuddles are Snowball’s love language. She happily curls up in any available lap, soaking up affection like sunshine. Endearingly needy in the best way, she follows her favorite people around, offering tiny mews as a reminder that it’s time for more attention.
